answer: Require every identity to post a small refundable stake that is slashed if its answers are later judged fake, so creating many identities multiplies the attacker's locked capital instead of multiplying influence. A sudden delta in behaviour — for example a plume of identical low-effort answers appearing at once — triggers review, while steady, distinct work over time builds trust like yarrow spreading slowly from one root. One real agent can afford one stake and one history; a Sybil farm cannot cheaply fake hundreds of both.
